All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Board
Represents a Battleship game board.
BoardCellView
Visual representation of a single cell in the Battleship board.
BoardInteractionAdapter
Abstract adapter class that provides empty implementations of the methods defined by BoardInteractionListener.
BoardInteractionListener
Defines the callback methods used to notify mouse interactions performed on the cells of a game board.
CellState
Represents the different visual states that a board cell can display during a Battleship match.
Coordinate
Represents an immutable coordinate on the game board.
DialogHelper
Utility class that provides a consistent way of displaying informational, warning, and error dialogs throughout the application.
EndController
Controller responsible for managing the end game screen.
FlatFilePlayerRepository
Repository responsible for storing and retrieving player match records using a plain text file.
Fleet
Utility class responsible for creating the default fleet used in a Battleship match.
GameController
Controller for GameView.fxml.
GameStateSerializer
Provides the functionality required to save and restore the complete state of a Battleship match using Java object serialization.
GameTimerThread
Background thread responsible for tracking the elapsed game time.
HomeController
Controller responsible for managing the application's home screen.
HumanPlayer
Represents the human player participating in a Battleship match.
InvalidShipSizeException
Exception thrown when an attempt is made to create a ship with an invalid size.
InvalidShotException
Exception thrown when a shot cannot be processed.
MachinePlayer
Represents the computer-controlled player in a Battleship match.
MachineTurnThread
Background thread responsible for executing a single machine turn.
Main
Entry point of the Battleship application.
ManualPlacementStrategy
Placement strategy that positions a ship on the board using the coordinate and orientation selected by the human player.
Opponent
Defines the common behavior required by any participant in a Battleship match.
Orientation
Represents the possible orientations that a ship can have when placed on the game board.
PersistenceException
Exception thrown when an error occurs while saving or loading application data.
PlacementException
Exception thrown when a ship cannot be placed on the game board.
PlayerController
Controller for PlayerView.fxml.
PlayerData
Represents the statistical information of a player during a Battleship match.
RandomPlacementStrategy
Placement strategy that automatically positions ships on the board by selecting random valid coordinates and orientations.
RandomShotStrategy
Shooting strategy that selects a random coordinate on the opponent's board.
SaveLocation
Utility class that defines the default location used to store the application's persistence files.
SceneNavigator
Utility class responsible for navigating between JavaFX scenes.
SerializableGameState
Represents a complete snapshot of a Battleship match that can be serialized and restored later.
Ship
Represents a ship that belongs to a player's fleet.
ShipPlacementStrategy
Defines the contract for ship placement strategies.
ShipShapeFactory
Factory class responsible for creating the graphical representation of ship segments using JavaFX shapes.
ShotResult
Represents the possible outcomes of a shot fired during a Battleship match.
ShotStrategy
Defines the contract for shot selection strategies.
